items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Well in 1964 you recorded with Ben Webster

ctx.x: I guess so. It was a while ago. I mean it never seemed to be so far out that it left any kind of musicality. That was always there.
Well in 1964 you recorded with Ben Webster, Maynard Ferguson, Wes Montgomery, Sonny Rollins—
